launch.title: Move Zeroes Explained | Two Pointers | InterviewReel
launch.description:
Move all zeroes to the end in place, while preserving the order of non-zero values. Follow read pointer r and write pointer w through [0, 1, 0, 3, 12]. One pass: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

Your turn: try [0, 0, 5]. Comment your final array and which value moves first.

Practice constraints: 0 <= n <= 100000, signed 32-bit integers. Target runtime: 1 second (practice target, not a hardware-independent guarantee).

Thanks for watching InterviewReel! Like, subscribe, and comment your answer.

Original deterministic visuals with AI-generated narration. #DSA #CodingInterview #TwoPointers
